duas.title: Supplication of Refuge and Trust in Allah
duas.text_transliteration: Allāh, Allāhu Rabbī lā ushriku bihi shay'a.
duas.text_arabic: اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّي لا أُشْـرِكُ بِهِ شَيْـئاً
duas.text_english: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.

reference.additional_references: See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/335

duas.occasion: When needing to seek refuge and affirm monotheism
duas.recitation_notes: Should be recited with intention and full heart, affirming that Allah alone is the Lord and Master of all affairs.

chapter_context.description: This chapter focuses on the supplication for seeking refuge in Allah and declaring His oneness, emphasizing complete trust in and reliance upon Allah.
